J1.evidence: The flagged point itself is acceptable: in «خافَ أنْ يَأْتِيَها مِن غَيْرِ جِهَتِهِ» the pronoun most naturally refers to Zakariyyā (her guardian), so 'from some source other than through him' is a defensible rendering. These need to be put in [Translator's note: …].

J2.evidence: Reviewer's pronoun claim is a false alarm: in «خافَ أنْ يَأْتِيَها مِن غَيْرِ جِهَتِهِ» the pronoun refers to Zakariyyā, her guardian (كَفَّلَها), so 'from some source other than through him' is right (TR agrees). Per the binding rule these explanatory additions must be inside [Translator's note: …]. Otherwise the translation is accurate.
